description: Fine film grain on mid gray. Fill a rectangle with it in tile mode and set blendingMode Overlay or SoftLight with opacity 0.1 to 0.3.
Soft paper or felt texture on mid gray. Fill a rectangle with it in tile mode and set blendingMode Overlay or SoftLight with opacity 0.2 to 0.5.
White topographic contour lines on a clear background. Fill a rectangle with it in tile mode and set opacity 0.05 to 0.2.
Broad green leaf with a lit left half and a shaded right half. Points up with the stem at the bottom. Place it with svgFile and turn it with rotation.
Long narrow green leaf, like eucalyptus or willow, with a slight curve. Points up with the stem at the bottom. Place it with svgFile and turn it with rotation.
Dry brown leaf with a serrated edge, like elm or beech, with faint spots. Points up with the stem at the bottom. Place it with svgFile and turn it with rotation.
Pale tan dried leaf, narrow, with faint spots. Points up with the stem at the bottom. Place it with svgFile and turn it with rotation.
Fresh bright green leaf for a highlight or a leaf floating on its own. Points up with the stem at the bottom. Place it with svgFile and turn it with rotation.
